english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making someone act, and it also covers causing a reluctant reaction such as a laugh or smile.

exampleSentences.english: They force me to agree immediately.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bik1 ngo5 zik1 hak1 daap3 jing3

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when a person or circumstance forces someone to act.

exampleSentences.english: They compel me to hand in the report today.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢逼我今日一定要交份報告。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 bik1 ngo5 gam1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone is forced or pressured to do something.

exampleSentences.english: My boss used pressure to oblige me to work late today.
exampleSentences.traditional: 老闆逼我今日返工返到好夜。
exampleSentences.jyutping: lou5 baan2 bik1 ngo5 gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 faan1 dou3 hou2 je6

english.note: Use this when pressing means forcing, driving someone back, or putting strong pressure on someone to accept or do something.

exampleSentences.english: Don’t press me to agree right away.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 bik1 ngo5 zik1 hak1 daap3 jing3

english.note: Use this when someone is compelled or pushed hard to do something through pressure or force.

exampleSentences.english: My boss can drive me to work overtime every night.
exampleSentences.jyutping: go3 lou5 baan2 bik1 ngo5 maan5 maan5 gaa1 baan1

english.note: Use this when causing someone to do something is forceful or coercive, making them act against their will.

exampleSentences.english: Their threats can cause me to apologize immediately.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋啲威脅逼我即刻道歉。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 di1 wai1 hip3 bik1 ngo5 zik1 hak1 dou6 hip3
